vulnerability.name: USN-8398-4
vulnerability.description: USN-8398-3 fixed a vulnerability in nginx. This update provides the corresponding fix for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that nginx incorrectly handled certain cookie headers in  the HTTP/2 implementation. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue  to cause nginx to consume excessive resources, resulting in a denial of  service.

statements.status_notes: nginx could be made to consume excessive resources if it received specially crafted network traffic. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
